name: Croatia
dossier:
The Croatia national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Vatreni, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 10 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The ultimate big-game team  -  small nation, enormous heart, and a maestro's last waltz.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Croatia will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group L and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group L. The connection between Luka Modrić and Joško Gvardiol is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Luka Modrić - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Croatia are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Luka Modrić, the 2018 Ballon d'Or winner, is chasing one final tournament miracle at 40 years old.
Croatia boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Runners-up (2018), Third (2022).
